name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet about hip width.
Keep the ribs down and press through both feet.
Lift the pelvis until hips line up with shoulders and knees.
Pause, then lower the pelvis with control.
cues: Squeeze the glutes at the top.
Keep both sides of the pelvis level.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to gain height.
breathing: Exhale as you lift; inhale as you lower.
